integrity: The cycle gauge law and moment identity are proved analytically. The bundled finite computations only corroborate the formulas and are not treated as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for simple cycles with uniform edge modulus. The theorem classifies cycle-phase gauge behavior and the first flux-sensitive spectral moment; it does not give a closed spectrum or a uniform gap formula for all even cycles or arbitrary multicyclic graphs.
title: Cycle-parity gauge law for phase-shifted EPR-like Hamiltonians
